evidence_for.quote: The proposal needs their six differences, not counterfactual trajectories, a new controller, an extra rollout or a native ABI change.

evidence_for.quote: Reopening conditions: a new learning proposal that selects one information, representation, credit or optimization intervention on the existing reusable path

evidence_against.quote: There are only six decisions, so the original lambda weighting at the earliest decision is .95^5 = .7737809375, not a very long delayed-reward chain.
evidence_against.why: 原方法已能学习，新标签不保证降低方差；可能没有足够新的决策价值。

evidence_against.quote: Both final learners remain below BCRH on all four metrics in both zones.
evidence_against.why: 既有收益不支持 MAPR 特有效益，BCRH 差距也没有被定位为时间信用问题。
